title: Price versus performance value
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on whether the G70's price feels justified by its performance, power, and overall value.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the G70 offers strong value for the money through excellent performance, good power, or a well-equipped package.

negative.summary: The lone negative review says the car feels lacking in price-to-performance value despite otherwise favorable features and options.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention high prices, price levels, or whether the car meets its price point, but the short fragments often lack enough context to assign clear approval or disapproval.

limitations: A large share of the sampled fragments are too short or incomplete to determine clear sentiment.
Some undetermined fragments refer to unrelated pricing subjects, such as accessories or windshield price, so the topic is not fully coherent around vehicle value alone.
The available examples are limited, so they do not show the full range of positive wording within this topic.
